title: Text: DET Tom Moore ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Sorry I missed your call the other day. I hope all is well and glad to hear the trip went well. I just read the article, great job! Thanks very much for the positive coverage. I hope it was a good experience for you.
No problem. Thank you, and thank you for all the help in coordinating this. It was an awesome time and I can’t stress enough how helpful Oliver was
I will give you a call in the next couple days - I am doing another feature on the Dominican facility, highlighting other players for next Sunday
That’s great to hear. I’m glad you were able to see the operation first hand. Sounds good on the call.
